messages.content: You are MiniMax M3.1 flash, the director of this film, now writing its contest entry. You state only what the facts you are given say. Answer only through the submit_entry function.

You directed the film "One Ticket, 800 Years". It is finished. Write two texts for the contest entry form, in English.

## 1. summary (at most 200 characters, counted strictly)

One or two vivid, concrete sentences a viewer would want to click: the city, the ride, the sweep of
[personal memory removed at the maker's request] Every fact in it must be in the film facts below. No hashtags, no
emoji, no URL, no quotation marks around the whole text.

## 2. director_notes (at most 1,400 characters)

A plain, factual account for the judges of how the film was made: the actual pipeline (the stages in
order), which model did what (name the models exactly as written below), the tools and data
sources, how many MiniMax M3.1 flash calls directed and fact-checked the film, what the whole film
cost, and what the human maker decided (from the human log below; describe him as "the maker",
never by name). Say that every creative decision and every line of the script came from MiniMax
M3.1 flash via SandBase, and that the code only checks and executes.
Write in short sentences or "label: value" lines. No marketing language.

## Rules

- Use ONLY the numbers, names and facts given below. Do not round a number into a different one
  and do not add a number that is not here. If a fact is not below, leave it out.
- No URL except (none: write no URL at all).
- No names of private persons.

## Film facts

Title: One Ticket, 800 Years
Logline: One Yellow Line ride from Chandni Chowk to Qutab Minar carries Delhi forward from Shah Jahan's city of 1639 to 1931 and 1947, then turns the clock back through the Tughlaq and Tomar ruins to the Qutb of around 1199 and an iron pillar older than any of them - a city that keeps being rebuilt by people who arrive.
City: Delhi (India). Ride: Yellow Line (Delhi Metro), Chandni Chowk to Qutab Minar: 16 stations, 17.739 km of line as mapped in OpenStreetMap.
Final film: 170.9 s, 1920x1080 (16:9) and 1080x1920 (9:16), English narration with burned-in subtitles, on-screen citation chips and a sources list.
Scenes (14): s01 title "One Ticket, Long Story"; s02 map "Chandni Chowk" 1639-1648; s03 illustration "Chandni Chowk" 1648; s04 map "Chawri Bazaar" 1656; s05 map "Patel Chowk" 1724; s06 map "Central Secretariat" 1931; s07 illustration "Old Delhi" 1947; s08 map "Malviya Nagar" 1947-1950; s09 map "Saket"; s10 map "Qutb Minar" c. [personal memory removed at the maker's request]
Pipeline (TimeLine stages, in order): geo (OpenStreetMap via Overpass: the line, its stations, a 3D city) -> ground (evidence pack from Wikidata, Wikipedia and a curated facts file: 307 sources) -> direct (M3.1 flash: treatment, script, self-critique) -> verify (M3.1 flash checks every claim against the excerpts it cites; repair rounds rewrite failing scenes) -> art (M3.1 flash: landmark painting prompts) -> assets (voice, images, music) -> timing -> render (three.js 3D map in a system browser via playwright-core) -> mix (ffmpeg) -> package (this entry).
Director: MiniMax M3.1 flash (minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash) via SandBase. It wrote the treatment, stops, script, on-screen text, every image prompt and the music prompt; code only checks evidence and structure and executes.
Voice: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD (minimax/speech/2.8/hd), 14 narration clips, a custom voice designed with MiniMax Voice Design (minimax/voice-design), chosen by the maker.
Images: Google Nano Banana 2.1 (google/nano-banana-2.1), 11 paintings in the film (6 scene paintings, 5 landmark paintings) plus the cover.
Music: MiniMax Music 2.6 (minimax/music/2.6), instrumental, 1 track.
Data and tools: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass; Wikidata; Wikipedia; NASA Earth Observatory Black Marble (Earth at night) for the opening globe; three.js; playwright-core with the system's Edge or Chrome; ffmpeg.
M3.1 flash director calls behind this film (logged in build/director with prompt, reasoning and answer): 19 (direct 6: treatment 2, script 2, critique 2; verify 12: verify 9, repair 3; art 1: art 1; 3 of them retries after code checks; 5 replayed from the cache of earlier identical paid calls).
M3.1 flash calls in the project's whole cost ledger (all takes and tests): 74, 1.21M prompt and 0.41M completion tokens, $0.43.
Media generation in the ledger: $1.18 (MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD 14 run(s) $0.16; Google Nano Banana 2.1 13 run(s) $0.86; MiniMax Music 2.6 1 run(s) $0.15).
Total SandBase spend in the ledger: $1.60 (spend cap $1.65). The custom voice was designed once with MiniMax Voice Design, outside this ledger.
Fact check: 30 claims (24 historical facts against 42 distinct source pages, 6 personal lines against the maker's own words): 30 supported, 0 partial, 0 unsupported after 3 repair round(s); passed.
The maker's review notes (3, on s03, s13, s14) went to the director as repair issues: M3.1 flash rewrote those lines itself.
Sources listed with this entry: 25.
